You will be working closely with the Commercial, Product and Legal teams while collaborating with some of the biggest merchants processing on the Adyen platform, all with one overarching goal: limiting Adyen’s exposure to credit losses. Our&nbsp; team is highly motivated, extremely innovative, and thrives on shared success. As we operate globally, our team is part of an international team with diverse backgrounds and skill sets. ...t;We are looking for a Senior Machine Learning Scientist to help build the machine learning capabilities behind Adyen’s Identity Platform.</p> <p>Adyen processes payments and financial events at global scale. To prevent fraud and financial crime effectively, we need to understand likely entities and relevant behavioural patterns across events, while maintaining a high bar for privacy, governance, reliability, and explainability.&nbsp;The Identity Platform develops shared capabilities that help Adyen understand which events and identifiers may belong to the same underlying person or actor. These capabilities serve multiple downstream teams and use cases, including real-time fraud prevention, AML detection, investigations, and future risk products.</p> <p>You will help design and build the ML systems that make this possible. This includes applied modelling, large-scale data processing, low-latency serving, clear interfaces for downstream consumers, and the operational controls required for a platform used across teams.</p> <p>This is a hands-on technical leadership role. You will influence long-term technical direction while remaining close to implementation, experimentation, and production systems.</p> <p><strong>In this role, you will:&nbsp;</strong></p> <ul> <li>Research, design, implement, train, deploy and monitor machine learning algorithms, either for batch prediction or real-time. Examples include: on-line learning algorithms to pick the best optimization decision in a changing environment, clustering algorithms to group customers/shoppers, supervised and semi-supervised learning methods for inference on risk patterns or graph analysis, representation learning for behavior prediction and monitoring, Anti-Money Laundering (AML) systems and real-time anomaly detection based on time-series modeling;</li> <li>Develop orchestrated pipelines for analytical purposes and machine learning training;</li> <li>Contribute to ongoing automation efforts for our experiments, training runs, validation runs and monitoring before, during and after deployment.
